sentences.text: This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.42/2024 registered at Police Station Gorakhpur, District Jabalpur for the offence punishable under Section 376(2)(n) of IPC and Section 5(L) & 6 of POCSO Act.
2. It is contended by the counsel that the allegation against the applicant is that on the false pretext of marriage, he committed rape upon the prosecutrix who was minor and also got her pregnant.
It is contended by the counsel that the prosecutrix and applicant were know to each other and she did not disclose the incident to anyone until she felt pain in her stomach.

It is further contended by the counsel that the father of the prosecutrix and the present applicant worked together as white washer and on account of some dispute between them, the applicant is being implicated in the offence in question.
The applicant is in custody since 20/01/2024 and trial would take considerable time to conclude, therefore, the applicant be released on bail.

The counsel for the State has opposed the application and submitted that the offence has been committed with minor on the false pretext of marriage who later on got pregnant, therefore, the applicant is not entitled to be released on bail.

5. Heard the submissions and perusal from case diary it reflects that on the false pretext of marriage,
offence of rape has been committed with the minor girl who also got pregnant larer on.

Therefore,
looking to the conduct of the present applicant, this Court is not inclined to release the applicant on bail.
